formation.note: No fetched source states a formation date.

intervals.label: collaboration active
intervals.note: Start is the arXiv submission month of the first collaboration paper found; no formation date is published. End is the end of data taking; the collaboration published its final analyses in 2025.
intervals.quote: PROSPECT is conceived as a 2-phase experiment

intervals.label: collaboration completed
intervals.note: Marks the end of data taking, not a dissolution date.
intervals.quote: PROSPECT-I detector data acquired between March and October 2018

summary.plain: The group of mostly American physicists who built and ran the PROSPECT reactor-antineutrino experiment at Oak Ridge National Laboratory.
summary.technical: Collaboration of US laboratories and universities (BNL, Drexel, Georgia Tech, IIT, LLNL, NIST, ORNL, Temple, Tennessee, Wisconsin, William and Mary, Yale and others, plus Waterloo) operating PROSPECT at HFIR.
